saySamples.text: 📋 A person, maybe 40s, with weathered hands wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."

Water over stone, loud enough to cover your noise. You could drink here without announcing it.
✅ You saw the creek. Tim nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
